f.n: Grand Bay National Wildlife Refuge
f.pu: Grand Bay National Wildlife Refuge is a study in transition. Here, the waterlogged wet pine savannas give way to the marshes, freshwater streams, and bayous of the Escatawpa River system. Slowly these freshwater systems system wind their way toward the Mississippi Sound and ultimately the Gulf of M…
f.re: 1. Fishing is prohibited from legal sunset to legal sunrise. 2. Anglers may enter the refuge no earlier than 30 minutes prior to sunrise and must leave the refuge no later than 30 minutes after legal sunset each day. 3. The use of airboats, mudboats, motorized pirogues, and air-cooled propulsion engines are prohibited.
